verses.translation: A Prayer of David. Hearken, O Lord of my righteousness, attend to my petition; give ear to my prayer not uttered with deceitful lips.

translations.ron: Auzi, Doamne, dreptatea mea, ia aminte cererea mea, ascultă rugăciunea mea, din buze fără de viclenie.
translations.grk: Προσευχὴ τοῦ Δαυίδ. Εἰσάκουσον Κύριε τῆς δικαιοσύνης μου, πρόσχες τῇ δεήσει μου· ἐνώτισαι τὴν προσευχήν μου οὐκ ἐν χείλεσι δολίοις.

verses.translation: Let my judgment come forth from thy presence; let mine eyes behold righteousness.

translations.ron: De la faţa Ta judecata mea să iasă, ochii mei să vadă cele drepte.
translations.grk: Ἐκ προσώπου σου τὸ κρίμα μου ἐξέλθοι, οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἰδέτωσαν εὐθύτητας.

verses.translation: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me by night; thou hast tried me as with fire, and unrighteousness has not been found in me: I am purposed that my mouth shall not speak amiss.

translations.ron: Cercetat-ai inima mea, noaptea ai cercetat-o; cu foc m-ai lămurit, dar nu s-a aflat întru mine nedreptate.
translations.grk: Ἐδοκίμασας τὴν καρδίαν μου, ἐπεσκέψω νυκτὸς, ἐπύρωσάς με, καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθη ἐν ἐμοὶ ἀδικία·

verses.translation: As for the works of men, by the words of thy lips I have guarded myself from hard ways.

translations.ron: Ca să nu grăiască gura mea lucruri omeneşti, pentru cuvintele buzelor Tale eu am păzit căi aspre.
translations.grk: ὅπως ἂν μὴ λαλήσῃ τὸ στόμα μου. Τὰ ἔργα τῶν ἀνθρώπων, διὰ τοὺς λόγους τῶν χειλέων σου ἐγὼ ἐφύλαξα ὁδοὺς σκληράς.

verses.translation: Direct my steps in thy paths, that my steps slip not.

translations.ron: Îndreaptă picioarele mele în cărările Tale, ca să nu şovăie paşii mei.
translations.grk: Κατάρτισαι τὰ διαβήματά μου ἐν ταῖς τρίβοις σου, ἵνα μὴ σαλευθῇ τὰ διαβήματά μου.

verses.translation: I have cried, for thou heardest me, O God: incline thine ear to me, and hearken to my words.

translations.ron: Eu am strigat, că m-ai auzit Dumnezeule; pleacă urechea Ta către mine şi auzi cuvintele mele.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ ἐκεκραξα, ὅτι ἐπήκουσας μου ὁ Θεός· κλῖνον τὸ οὖς σου ἐμοὶ, καὶ εἰσάκουσον τῶν ῥημάτων μου.

verses.translation: Shew the marvels of thy mercies, thou that savest them that hope in thee.

translations.ron: Minunate fă milele Tale, Cel ce mântuieşti pe cei ce nădăjduiesc în Tine de cei ce stau împotriva dreptei Tale.
translations.grk: Θαυμάστωσον τὰ ἐλέη σου, ὁ σώζων τοὺς ἐλπίζοντας ἐπὶ σέ· ἐκ τῶν ἀνθεστηκότων τῇ δεξιᾷ σου,

verses.translation: Keep me as the apple of the eye from those that resist thy right hand: thou shalt screen me by the covering of thy wings,

translations.ron: Păzeşte-mă, Doamne, ca pe lumina ochilor; cu acoperământul aripilor Tale acoperă-mă
translations.grk: φύλαξόν με ὡς κόρην ὀφθαλμοῦ· ἐν σκέπῃ τῶν πτερύγων σου σκεπάσεις με,

verses.translation: from the face of the ungodly that have afflicted me: mine enemies have compassed about my soul.

translations.ron: De faţa necredincioşilor care mă necăjesc pe mine. Vrăjmaşii mei sufletul meu l-au cuprins;
translations.grk: ἀπὸ προσώπου ἀσεβῶν τῶν ταλαιπωρησάντων με· οἱ ἐχθροί μου τὴν ψυχήν μου περιέσχον.

verses.translation: They have enclosed themselves with their own fat: their mouth has spoken pride.

translations.ron: Cu grăsime inima lor şi-au încuiat, gura lor a grăit mândrie.
translations.grk: Τὸ στέαρ αὐτῶν συνέκλεισαν, τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν ἐλάλησεν ὑπερηφανίαν.

verses.translation: They have now cast me out and compassed me round about: they have set their eyes so as to bow them down to the ground.

translations.ron: Izgonindu-mă acum m-au înconjurat, ochii lor şi-au aţintit ca să mă plece la pământ.
translations.grk: Ἐκβαλόντες με νυνὶ περιεκύκλωσάν με, τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτὼν ἔθεντο ἐκκλῖναι ἐν τῇ γῇ.

verses.translation: They laid wait for me as a lion ready for prey, and like a lion's whelp dwelling in secret places.

translations.ron: Apucatu-m-au ca un leu gata de pradă, ca un pui de leu ce locuieşte în ascunzişuri.

verses.translation: Arise, O Lord, prevent them, and cast them down: deliver my soul from the ungodly: draw thy sword,

translations.ron: Scoală-Te, Doamne, întâmpină-i pe ei şi împiedică-i! Izbăveşte sufletul meu de cel necredincios, cu sabia Ta.

verses.translation: because of the enemies of thine hand: O Lord, destroy them from the earth; scatter them in their life, though their belly has been filled with thy hidden treasures: they have been satisfied with uncleanness, and have left the remnant of their possessions to their babes.

translations.ron: Doamne, desparte-mă de oamenii acestei lumi, ce-şi iau partea în viaţă, căci s-a umplut pântecele lor de bunătăţile Tale; săturatu-s-au fiii lor şi au lăsat rămăşiţele pruncilor.

verses.translation: But I shall appear in righteousness before thy face: I shall be satisfied when thy glory appears.

translations.ron: Iar eu întru dreptate mă voi arăta feţei Tale, sătura-mă-voi când se va arăta slava Ta.
